mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in GDP growth below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below 1.5% for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of sustained GDP weakness are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces corporate profit margins and consumer spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising unemployment are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index below 100 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of declining industrial production are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of monetary tightening are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month rise in the real sales of domestic product above 5% signals accelerating aggregate demand, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises above 5% for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of accelerating demand growth are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
